display.purpose: TikCal wordmark only — chrome-gradient text-fill, never page content.

section-headline.purpose: Fixed 26px Syne view-title heading ("August 2026", "Week of Aug 16–22") — same size in MonthView/WeekView/DayView.

body.purpose: Event titles, notes, primary reading content (Schibsted Grotesk).

label.purpose: All metadata: dates, counts, venues, status, button text (IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, tracked). Steps by local density, not component type: 9px (tightest caption) / 10px (most common) / 11px (SecLabel default) / 12.5px (chip/badge) / 13px (largest, near-body weight).

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Default HudBox elevation — inset highlight + soft ambient dark glow, no directional drop-shadow.

shadows.name: card-hero
shadows.purpose: Elevated/hero HudBox (popovers, featured panels) — violet-tinted ambient wash.

shadows.name: button-aurora
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA glow, matches the aurora gradient fill.

motion.name: zoom-in
motion.purpose: Incoming calendar view on Month/Week/Day zoom transitions.

motion.name: zoom-out
motion.purpose: Outgoing calendar view on zoom transitions.

motion.name: step-enter
motion.purpose: Incoming period on swipe/arrow-key step navigation.

motion.name: step-exit
motion.purpose: Outgoing period on step navigation — faster than enter so motion reads as settling, not a carousel.

motion.name: interactive-press
motion.purpose: Shared active-state press-down across buttons, chips, cards, rail controls.

components.name: Primary Button (Aurora)
components.description: The one CTA-strength button — gradient chrome fill, reserved for a screen's primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-aurora { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #c04bff, #8b5cff); border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 20px; transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.15s; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(192,75,255,0.6); } .ds-btn-aurora:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-aurora:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8b5cff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-aurora:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary/cancel action — hairline border, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #cbd5e1; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 20px; transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8b5cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Event Card
components.description: The primary list row — colored spine carries the event's crew/artist hue, avatar chip shows initials.
components.html:
FJ
Open Air
AUG 22 · KNOCKDOWN CENTER
components.css: .ds-card-event { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background: rgba(21,21,28,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 14px 14px 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04), 0 10px 30px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-card-event:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-spine { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px; border-radius: 4px; background: #8b5cff; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(139,92,255,0.4); } .ds-card-avatar { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #8b5cff; background: rgba(139,92,255,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,255,0.4); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; color: #e8f4f8; } .ds-card-sub { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled field — mono uppercase caption above, quiet border-color focus (no ring).
components.html: Event Title
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.045); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px; color: #e8f4f8; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #475569; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(139,92,255,0.6); }

components.name: Crew Chip
components.description: Data-hue badge — never chrome-colored, always the crew's own reserved color.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(76,201,240,0.4); color: #4cc9f0; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4cc9f0; }

components.name: HUD Panel
components.description: Signature surface primitive underlying cards, popovers, and forms — inset highlight, glow-not-shadow elevation, optional violet hero wash.
components.css: .ds-hudbox { background: rgba(21,21,28,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04), 0 10px 30px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); padding: 16px; } .ds-hudbox.hero { border-color: rgba(139,92,255,0.3); background: rgba(139,92,255,0.07); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06), 0 16px 40px -12px rgba(139,92,255,0.35); }

narrative.overview: TikCal's whole surface is a near-black room lit by one thing: a stage-light bloom bleeding in from the top of the screen. Everything else — panels, text, borders — recedes into the dark and lets that one wash of color read as the room's only real light source. The interface isn't decorated with gradients; it's lit by one. That light is chrome, not paint. Aurora/violet/iris exist to signal "this is TikCal speaking" — wordmark, hero, primary CTA, the calendar's today-marker, links, focus rings — and nowhere else. Data carries its own, separate hues (crew colors, mint, RSVP, the one reserved orange), and the chrome deliberately never touches them: the glow illuminates the room, it doesn't relabel what's standing in it. Voice matches the visual: nightlife/rave vernacular (totem names like "The Press," "Glow Stick"), never corporate polish.
keyCharacteristics: One chrome light source (magenta→violet→iris), used sparingly, never as a flat fill on large surfaces
Reserved, separate data hues that the chrome never repaints
Flat, glow-lit depth — no drop-shadow hierarchy
Mono labels for anything data/metadata; humanist sans for content

rules.name: The Chrome-Only Rule
rules.body: Aurora/violet/iris are reserved for "TikCal-is-speaking" moments (brand, navigation, focus, primary action). They never appear as an event's, crew's, or RSVP's identity color.

rules.name: The Reserved-Hue Rule
rules.body: Crew colors, mint, RSVP amber/coral, and the reserved orange (Overlap free/GO only) are semantic data, not decoration. A new UI surface reaches for chrome; a new meaning gets its own reserved hue.

rules.name: The Retired-Cyan Rule
rules.body: Cyan and ice were the old chrome and are fully retired from that role; ice survives only as one selectable crew color.

rules.name: The Mono-Speaks-Data Rule
rules.body: If a string is a date, count, venue, or status, it's IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, tracked wide. If it's prose a human wrote, it's Schibsted Grotesk.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Elevation reads through an ambient color wash and a hairline top highlight, never a hard offset shadow. A surface that needs to feel raised gets hero (brighter border, violet wash), not a heavier box-shadow.

dos: Do treat aurora/violet/iris as a single warm-to-cool sweep (a gradient family), not three interchangeable flat accents.
Do give every interactive element the same three states: hover (brightness/border), focus-visible (violet ring), active (scale-down).
Do put dates, counts, venues, and status in IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, tracked wide.
Do build elevation from an inset highlight + ambient glow, never a hard offset shadow.
donts: Don't use cyan or ice as a UI accent — that chrome role is retired; ice survives only as a crew-color option.
Don't use the reserved orange anywhere but Overlap's free/GO state.
Don't recolor a crew badge, RSVP status, or the mint "shared" hue with chrome violet.
Don't add a literal measured grid/floor line pattern to backgrounds — depth comes from blurred ambient bloom, not graph-paper geometry.
